question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"conjured."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Conjured" **means to bring to mind or imagine something, often through magic or supernatural means. (जादू करने जैसी हाथ की सफ़ाई दिखाना; बाज़ीगरी दिखाना)

 
 
• **Example**: *She **conjured**__ up a memory of her childhood home.*
 
 
 
• The past tense of **"conjure" **is **"conjured."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• Correct passage:

The Grim Reaper seems to have __appeared__ in Europe during the 14th century. It was during this time that Europe was dealing with what was then the world’s __worst__ pandemic, the Black Death, believed to be the result of the plague. It is estimated that about one-third of Europe’s entire population __perished__ as a result of the pandemic, with some areas of the continent suffering far greater losses than others. The original outbreak of the plague occurred during 1347–51, and outbreaks then __recurred__ several other times after that. So, clearly, death was something that the surviving Europeans had on their mind, and it is not surprising that they __**conjured**__ an image to represent it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Forced" **means to make someone do something against their will. (किसी को उसका अनचाहा काम करने के लिए विवश करना; बाध्य करना)
 
• **"Desired" **means to want or wish for something. (किसी चीज़ की चाहत या कामना करना)
 
• **"Compelled"** means to force someone to do something through persuasion or pressure. (कुछ करने के लिए किसी को बाध्य या विवश करना)
